    //==
    // # The linear tetrahedron
    //
    // The constant-strain tetrahedron (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tetrahedron):
    // four nodes, linear shape functions, and therefore one constant strain and
    // one constant stress per cell. It is the cheapest usable solid element and
    // the stiffest — a coarse mesh of these under-predicts deflection — but it
    // needs no numerical integration at all, which is exactly what makes it the
    // element to state first.

    // The four vertex indices of a cell, in stored order. (`Vertices` already

    // cell has no counterpart there yet.)
